title: Fee Schedule Footnote: Change Percent on Structurally Closed Design Studio Selections Files
content:
A fee-bearing change order on a Design Studio Selections file carries a change percent set by the file status and the price of the option lines the change order adds:

| File status | Price of the option lines added under the change order | Change percent |
|---|---|---|
| Structural closed | 5000.00 or more | 10 percent |
| Structural closed | Less than 5000.00 | 5 percent |
| Any other status | Any | None |

The price of the option lines added is the total price of every option line added under that change order number on the design ledger.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, structural closed file)**

- Lines added total 5000.00: 10 percent.
- Lines added total 4999.99: 5 percent.
- A change order that only removes lines adds 0.00, which is less than 5000.00: 5 percent.
- The same change orders on a file in selection: no change percent.
